subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw handle UUID-like Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: Source and docs show one setup key feeding both general and coding provider namespaces, but only a credentialed vendor-contract check can decide whether Lite keys should route to Coding Plan only, work on both endpoints, or fail earlier with clearer diagnostics.

options.title: Validate Lite contract first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the observed vendor contract.

options.title: Keep Lite keys Coding Plan-only
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid on `volcengine-plan`, keep the endpoints separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for general-model selections.

options.title: Support shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If the key should work on the general endpoint too, treat the 401 as an auth/header/runtime bug and fix that path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite contract first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the observed vendor contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled-provider ownership, setup docs, and runtime compatibility surfaces where the history is strongest.
